title: SEACrowd: A Multilingual Multimodal Data Hub and Benchmark Suite for Southeast Asian Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Gini coefficient to measure the equity of model performance across diverse Southeast Asian languages compared to high-resource languages, and training a text classifier to evaluate generation quality by distinguishing between natural language and Anglocentric 'translationese'.

Manually auditing and categorizing dataset subsets based on their origin (machine-translated from English, locally crawled, or hand-crafted) to estimate the cultural relevance and representation of Southeast Asian cultures.
